activities.explanation: 20 >= 18 is True, so the if-block executes and prints 'You are an adult'.
15 >= 18 is False, so the else-branch runs and prints 'You are a minor'.
7 >= 3 and 7 >= 1 are both True, so the first branch runs. elif and else are skipped.
c == 1 is False, c == 2 is True, so the second branch runs: 10 - 5 = 5.
The loop runs i=1 (prints 1), i=2 (prints 2), i=3 (break fires before print, loop ends). Nothing after 2 is printed.

source_section.heading: 4.8 break, continue, and pass in loops

activities.explanation: continue skips the rest of the loop body for the current iteration and moves to the next. When i=3, print is skipped; all others print.
